newsitem.title: USA: Dart Group says extends CEO settlement.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group says extends CEO settlement.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said Tuesday that it extended by 20 days the conditional settlement agreement in principle reached on April 21 between Dart and its chairman and chief executive Herbert Haft.
As already announced, implementation of the conditional agreement in principle is subject to the negotiation of a definitive settlement agreement, Dart said.
The conditional agreement in principle stated that it would terminate if a definitive settlement agreement were not entered into by May 9, Dart said.

That date was subsequently extended to May 23. Dart and Haft have not entered into a definitive settlement agreement, and the agreement in principle has been amended to state that it will terminate if a definitive agreement is not entered into by June 12, Dart said.
"The parties are having difficulty resolving outstanding issues in the negotiations," a statement issued by Dart said.
If a definitive settlement agreement is not reached by June 12, there can be no assurance that the parties will agree to another extension of the conditional agreement in principle, Dart said.
